shared_identity: Ren Nanase, project age 21, emerald-green eyes, muted mauve-purple hair, straight bangs, braided side crown gathered into a long low ponytail; surgery hair tucked into a teal cap; polished early-2000s visual-novel anime art.

slots.ward/neutral: Vertical 2:3 head-through-upper-thigh portrait; short-sleeved light mint-green patient gown; neutral slightly apprehensive expression; flat cool-gray background.
slots.intraoperative/tense: Frontal 4:3 head-and-shoulders portrait; cap, bare shoulders, collarbones and uppermost chest skin; no sterile drape, sheet, garment or other fabric visible; crop ends above the breast line; tense but composed; flat cool-gray background.
slots.operating_table/awake: High overhead complete-table 4:3 supine scene; awake; arms on armboards; opaque teal drape; natural compact proportions.
slots.operating_table_lithotomy/awake: High overhead compact procedure-chair 4:3 scene; bare shoulders above a high opaque drape; knees bent outward on two independent padded supports; open floor between supports.
slots.splash/general_anesthesia: Wide close head-and-upper-torso induction scene; eyes closed; transparent mask and continuous corrugated tube; bare shoulders above opaque chest drape.
slots.advanced/abdominal: Wide high three-quarter supine scene; mask, armboards and layered drapes; small rectangular abdominal preparation window; no incision or blood.
slots.advanced/chest: User-supplied advanced chest-position image; preserved unchanged as the selected candidate.
slots.advanced/lateral: Wide high longitudinal true side-lying position; profile head at anesthesia machine, both arms on forward supports, knees gently flexed, small flank window only.
slots.advanced/prone: Wide high rear three-quarter face-down position; padded face cradle, both arms supported forward, full-body teal coverage, normal neck and shoulder proportions.
